alloy.preparation: High-purity experimental alloy melted as small ingots; small coupons prepared by hot rolling. Mechanically polished coupon, exposed area 0.4 cm².

test_solution.preparation: Neutral 1 M KCl bulk solution; numerical pH and gas conditioning are unreported.

test_method.procedure_description: Start at −300 mV (SCE), then step potential upwards by 25 mV every 400 s on a mechanically polished coupon in 1 M KCl. Temperature 22 ± 1°C throughout. Pitting is checked using a binocular microscope. Separate wire artificial-pit and reverse-scan protection-potential procedures are not assigned as pitting-test pretreatment.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Pitting verified with a binocular microscope; Ep is the pitting potential in Table 3, distinct from Epp protection potential.

experiments.result_note: Pitting verified microscopically; potential stepped upward by 25 mV every 400 s. Ep is the pitting potential here; Epp is the separate protection potential. Reported as measured, without converting scale. Sulfur <0.005 wt% is an upper limit. The 1200°C/24-h anneal and water quench are explicitly described for wire artificial-pit electrodes, not assigned to these coupon pitting tests.
